items.reason: A gentle, non-active cleanser keeps skin clean without stripping or adding irritation around tender areas.
A simple barrier moisturizer helps support skin comfort, since moisture reads on the low side.
Daily mineral SPF helps keep the look of marks from darkening or lingering.

response.routine_note: Deep, painful lumps that leave marks are best looked at by a dermatologist rather than anything a shop can sell, so please book a visit instead of reaching for the strongest products. Until then, keep to this gentle routine and avoid scrubs, peels and high-strength actives that could irritate sore skin.
